text: nail --seed-mode prog (seed_stage.rs seed_progressive): one mmseqs prefilter at -s, then a loop of mmseqs align calls, one per round, each over a sliced prefilter db holding the next n_take hits of every still-active query; n_take starts at --prog-n and doubles; a query stops at max_seeds hits or when hits/n_take < --prog-f. Then nail merges the round align dbs and runs one convertalis. Every mmseqs call is a child process with --threads = nail's -t. static is prefilter, align, convertalis once each.
